description: This file defines the ShippingQuote class, which models shipping quote information including options, fees, and error states within a commerce platform.

classes.name: ShippingQuote
classes.description: A class representing a shipping quote, including options, costs, and error states.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: getShippingOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: setShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the code representing the shipping module used.

methods.name: setShippingReturnCode
methods.description: Sets the return code indicating success or specific errors.

methods.name: setFreeShipping
methods.description: Indicates whether free shipping is applicable.

methods.name: setFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Sets the threshold amount for free shipping eligibility.

methods.name: getFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the free shipping threshold amount.

methods.name: setApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Specifies whether tax should be applied on shipping.

methods.name: isApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Checks if tax application on shipping is enabled.

methods.name: getQuoteError
methods.description: Retrieves the error message related to this quote, if any.

methods.name: setQuoteError
methods.description: Sets the error message for this quote.
